race.comment: JIMMY'S BROTHER (5) returned to the winners' stall over this track and trip last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Gets some weight relief with the 1.5kg claim and should be right there at the business end again. OOHLALOUVRE (12) loves this sprint journey with two wins and nine placings from 14 attempts and doesn't know how to run a bad race. Has to be included in calculations. CONTILDA'S LOVE (7) is a four-time winner here who has been given a bit of a freshen up since the latest effort. In the mix on best figures. ESTRONDO (1) is resuming from a break. Placed in a recent trial at Doomben. Opened last campaign with a sixth at Eagle Farm over 1200m. Can feature fresh.
